title: cerastium glaucum var. octandrum
intro: Cerastium glaucum var. octandrum, commonly known as Snow-in-Summer, is a flowering plant in the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe and protect the skin. The therapeutic actions of Snow-in-Summer include its ability to calm irritated skin and reduce redness, making it a popular ingredient in skincare products. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
